title: ControlNotificationChannelUpdateRequest
description: Control Panel notification-channel update. Per-channel SMTP fields and uses_global_smtp are intentionally not accepted. migrate_to_global_smtp is the only supported delivery-mode transition: true migrates an existing legacy email channel to globally managed application SMTP, while omission or false preserves the current mode. Omitting email_recipients preserves the existing masked recipient set.

webhook_url.description: Optional write-only replacement for a Discord, Slack, or generic webhook URL. Omission preserves the existing encrypted URL; it is never returned raw.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are rejected.

email_recipients.description: Optional replacement recipient set. Omission preserves existing recipients; an explicitly empty array is invalid.

migrate_to_global_smtp.description: Set true to migrate an existing legacy email channel from per-channel SMTP to globally managed application SMTP. Omission or false preserves the current delivery mode; this request flag is never returned.
